headline: Sánchez wins 18th as Phillies top Mets 7-2
recap: The Phillies' most recent game remains Sunday's 7-2 win over the Mets at Citi Field, closing out the four-game series; Monday was an off day. Philadelphia scored twice in the first when Luis Arraez's sacrifice fly to left, on a tag play the Mets challenged and lost, brought home Kyle Schwarber, and Alec Bohm's single drove in Bryce Harper. The Phillies made it 4-0 in the third on Trea Turner's double, which scored Schwarber, and an Arraez single that brought home Turner. Bo Bichette's solo home run in the sixth and Brett Baty's RBI single in the seventh cut the deficit to 4-2, but Justin Crawford's three-run triple in the eighth, scoring Bryson Stott, Brandon Marsh and J.T. Realmuto, put it away. Cristopher Sánchez earned his 18th win, allowing two runs over 6 1/3 innings with six strikeouts and no walks; Jonah Tong took the loss for New York.
The Phillies are 86-70, second in the NL East, 6.0 games behind the first-place Braves, and carry a one-game winning streak into Tuesday.

Philadelphia opens a three-game home series against the Milwaukee Brewers on Tuesday. First pitch at Citizens Bank Park is scheduled for 6:40 PM ET, with Zack Wheeler starting for the Phillies against Milwaukee right-hander Dustin May. DraftKings lists the Phillies as -141 moneyline favorites.
